description.value: Keating Pizza has been a fixture near the Keating Industrial Park since 1989, serving generous 'Heavy Duty' pizza slices — up to nine varieties daily — alongside 33 specialty pizzas, chicken wings, poutine, and house-made desserts like Nanaimo Bars. It is a no-frills, locally rooted pizza shop with a loyal following and online ordering available. Cyclists passing through the Saanich Peninsula on Keating Cross Road would find it a filling and convenient meal stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Keating Pizza (keatingpizza.com) loaded successfully and confirms an active pizza restaurant operating since 1989 near Keating Industrial Park in Saanichton. The site lists phone 250-652-0772, an 'Order Online' feature, and a full menu of slices, specialty pizzas, chicken, desserts, and sides — no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities. Address on the website (2144 Keating Cross Road, Saanichton) differs from OSM (2144A Keating Cross Road, Sidney) — no unit suffix and a different community name, both flagged.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records '2144A Keating Cross Road' (with unit suffix 'A'), website lists '2144 Keating Cross Road' (no suffix).
Community discrepancy: OSM assigns this to Sidney, but website footer says Saanichton, BC — Keating Cross Road is in Central Saanich/Saanichton, not Sidney proper.
Website header has a typo: 'Keatiing Pizza' (double 'i') — not the canonical business name.
OSM record has no phone number; phone sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate long-standing pizza restaurant and plausible food stop for cyclists on the Saanich Peninsula, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence — a site visit or direct contact is needed before listing.
